 KMB’s Standalone PAT Up 2% QoQ At Rs4,212 Cr 
 KMB’s Standalone PAT Up 2% QoQ At Rs4,212 Cr
 Slippages for Q2FY27 decreased to Rs1,230 crore, down 24% YoY from Rs1,629 crore in Q2FY26. 
 FinTech BizNews Service    
 Mumbai, 24 October, 2026: The Board of Directors of Kotak Mahindra Bank (“the Bank”) approved the unaudited standalone and consolidated results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, at the Board meeting held in Mumbai, today.
 Kotak Mahindra Bank standalone results 
 During the quarter, the Bank mobilised FCNR(B) deposits aggregating to ~Rs 55,344 crore and provided loans aggregating to ~Rs 16,110 crore through it’s international branches.
 The Bank’s PAT for Q2FY27 increased to Rs 4,212 crore, up 29% YoY from Rs 3,253 crore in Q2FY26 (up 2% QoQ from Rs 4,123 crore in Q1FY27).
 Net Interest Income (NII) for Q2FY27 increased to Rs 8,459 crore, up 16% YoY from Rs 7,311 crore in Q2FY26 (up 7% QoQ from Rs 7,928 crore in Q1FY27).
 Net Interest Margin (NIM) for Q2FY27 stood at 4.31% versus 4.54% in Q2FY26 and 4.53% in Q1FY27. The moderation in NIM was largely on account of FCNR(B) mobilisation during the quarter.
 Cost of funds was 4.52% for Q2FY27 (4.70% for Q2FY26 and 4.46% for Q1FY27).
 Fees and services for Q2FY27 increased to Rs 2,926 crore, up 21% YoY from Rs 2,415 crore in Q2FY26 (up 17% QoQ from Rs 2,500 crore in Q1FY27).
 Operating expenses for Q2FY27 increased to Rs 5,271 crore, up 14% YoY from Rs 4,632 crore in Q2FY26 (up 3% QoQ from Rs 5,135 crore in Q1FY27). Cost to assets improved to 2.40% for Q2FY27 (2.67% for Q2FY26 and 2.66% for Q1FY27).
 Operating profit for Q2FY27 increased to Rs 6,382 crore, up 21% YoY from Rs 5,268 crore in Q2FY26 (up 4% QoQ from Rs 6,131 crore in Q1FY27).
 Provisions for Q2FY27 stood at Rs 803 crore, down 15% YoY from Rs 947 crore in Q2FY26 (from Rs 668 crore in Q1FY27). Credit cost (annualised) for Q2FY27 stood at 0.35% (0.79% for Q2FY26 and 0.46% for Q1FY27).
 Net Advances increased 25% YoY to Rs 577,295 crore as at September 30, 2026 from Rs 462,688 crore as at September 30, 2025. Excluding loans provided against FCNR (B) deposits and loan portfolio acquired from Kotak mahindra Investments Ltd (KMIL), net advances grew by 19% YoY.
 Customer Assets which comprise Advances (incl. IBPC & BRDS) and Credit Substitutes grew to Rs 626,801 crore as at September 30, 2026, up 23% YoY from Rs 509,399 crore as at September 30, 2025.
 Total period-end Deposits grew to Rs 651,491 crore for Q2FY27, up 23% YoY from Rs 528,776 crore for Q2FY26. Excluding FCNR (B) deposits, total deposits grew by 13% YoY.
 Average Total Deposits grew to Rs 606,234 crore for Q2FY27, up 19% YoY from Rs 510,138 crore for Q2FY26. Average Current Deposits grew to Rs 82,026 crore for Q2FY27, up 17% YoY from Rs 70,220 crore for Q2FY26. Average Fixed-rate Savings Deposits grew to Rs 129,731 crore for Q2FY27, up 14% YoY from Rs 113,894 crore for Q2FY26. Average Term Deposits grew to Rs 379,765 crore for Q2FY27, up 22% YoY from Rs 311,889 crore for Q2FY26.
 CASA ratio as at September 30, 2026 stood at 38.2% (42.3% as at September 30, 2025), reflecting the increase in the term deposit base due to FCNR (B) deposit inflows. Excluding FCNR (B) deposits, CASA ratio as at September 30, 2026 stood at 41.8%.
 Credit to Deposit ratio as at September 30, 2026 stood at 88.6% (87.5% as at September 30, 2025).
 Slippages for Q2FY27 decreased to Rs 1,230 crore, down 24% YoY from Rs 1,629 crore in Q2FY26. As at September 30, 2026, GNPA was 1.04% and NNPA was 0.24% (GNPA was 1.39% and NNPA was 0.32% as at
 September 30, 2025). As at September 30, 2026, Provision Coverage Ratio stood at 78% (77% as at September
 30, 2025).
 Standalone Return on Assets (ROA) for Q2FY27 (annualised) was 1.92%. Return on Equity (ROE) for Q2FY27 (annualised) was 11.65%.
 Capital Adequacy Ratio of the Bank, as per Basel III, as at September 30, 2026 was 21.9% and CET1 ratio was 21.4%.
 Customers as on September 30, 2026 were 5.1 crore.
 Consolidated results at a glance 
 Consolidated PAT for Q2FY27 stood at Rs 5,645 crore, up 26% YoY from Rs 4,468 crore in Q2FY26 (up 3% QoQ from Rs 5,480 crore in Q1FY27).

 Consolidated Customer Assets which comprise Advances (incl. IBPC & BRDS) and Credit Substitutes grew to
 Rs 699,250 crore as at September 30, 2026, up 21% YoY from Rs 576,339 crore as at September 30, 2025.
 Consolidated Customer Assets Under Management as at September 30, 2026 grew to Rs 814,118 crore, up 8% YoY from Rs 756,964 crore as at
 September 30, 2025. The total Domestic MF AUM increased by 10% YoY to Rs 615,679 crore as at September 30, 2026.
 Consolidated Networth as at September 30, 2026 was Rs 194,706 crore. The Book Value per Share increased to
 Rs 196 as at September 30, 2026, up 16% YoY from Rs 169 as at September 30, 2025. (computed based on subdivision of 1 equity share of face value of Rs 5 each into 5 equity shares of Rs 1 each with effect from 14th January, 2026).
 At the consolidated level, Return on Assets (ROA) for Q2FY27 (annualised) was 2.10%. Return on Equity (ROE) for Q2FY27 (annualised) was 11.70%.
 Consolidated Capital Adequacy Ratio as per Basel III as at September 30, 2026 was 22.4% and CET1 ratio was 22.1%. Consolidated Average Liquidity Coverage Ratio stood at 137.4% for Q2FY27.
